scope: secondary K=5 completion and exact-search implementation regression on previously viewed public crops; NOT new blind evidence
input_policy: reuse the exact gallery/validation/test manifests of protocol-mixed-v1-registered-seed42; no new filtering or resampling

primary_comparison.metric: test known correct identification / all known attempts
primary_comparison.safety_metric: test unknown false accepts / usable unknown faces, with Wilson interval

experiment.new_budget_interpretation: K=5 is secondary descriptive analysis only, never replace the original K=3 primary comparison based on test outcomes
experiment.regression_gate: all original 126 variants must retain exact selected hashes, validation thresholds/margins and test identification counts

limitations: Protocol was extended after original K=1/2/3 results were viewed; this is not historical preregistration.
Six gallery candidates per identity permit K=5 without adding or duplicating any photo.
Capture-session metadata is absent; the original crop/identity-preflight/dHash selection biases remain.
The extension is not evidence of camera generalization or low population FAR.
